delivery: dev increment after published 0.1.31; no new npm release
capability: Resume a safely checkpointed authorized repair in its original Session and native Goal under the remaining budget and original deadline.
boundaries: Durable fence binds authorization, iteration, Session, process generation, PID namespace and absolute deadline.
Cold Linux takeover requires the old process to be proven gone in the same PID namespace and no pending model/tool effects. Same-process reattachment requires prior release.
Tool completion clears its durable pending intent only after the native Session result is flushed.
A native or repair cancellation at normal model-stream return retains the pending effect even when the adapter returns without throwing.
Current owner, route, source evidence, profile, Policy, original native identity/revision/rounds and cumulative usage remain required.
Active/disarmed Goals can continue; completed Goals only reattach for evidence. Human pause, block, clear, expiry, revision or definition drift cannot be silently rearmed.
Legacy records without a fence, unfinished external requests, uncertain capture/comparison and unavailable process proof remain unknown. No TTL takeover or duplicate repair creation.

actualComponents: native Goal service and round driver
fixtureComponents: source failure evidence and Skills capability facade
assertions: first round execution, step acceptance and exact whole-goal not-achieved assessment settled before termination
same continuation, Session, business Goal, native Goal and definition
two rounds; cumulative 4 model calls and 2 tool calls
original absolute deadline preserved and execution fence advanced
second process writes and independently verifies a real artifact
live lease holder rejects a competing process

earlierFailure.observed: Second native round performed tool work but remained blocked at the round limit. Another instrumented run identified a pending whole-goal contract with attempts=0; its local log was later overwritten by the worker and is not presented as retained evidence.
earlierFailure.correction: Add a controlled regression for joining an in-flight verifier tick and guarantee one fresh post-admission cycle. The checkpoint now also waits for first-round whole-goal not-achieved acceptance, not merely a step receipt.

independentReview.method: separate read-only native verifier reviewed final source, matching frozen hashes, and actual targeted logs; full-check completion remains required
retainedConditions: same authorized native Goal and Session
unchanged remaining budget and absolute deadline
no takeover of a live or unconfirmed effect holder

traexReview.reason: The read-only source review exceeded its 240-second limit and was terminated. It is not a model-recovery test or a review PASS.

previousFullCheck.reason: Stopped the superseded check after the final focused runtime case reproduced missing whole-goal acceptance; it is not a passing full check.

controlledRegressions: native/repair signal abort after the terminal provider chunk retains pendingModel=1 after handle disposal
a real verifier cycle blocked behind a controlled HTTP gate is joined by a newly admitted outcome; a fresh cycle processes the new contract

limitations: Live-model crash recovery and the full production Skills-to-feedback journey were not exercised by this deterministic runtime test.
Cold takeover is Linux-only and cannot establish arbitrary external subprocess cleanup.
This change is not included in the immutable published v0.1.31 packages.
The full RSI roadmap and remaining real-task generalization are retained.
